title: 1984 (Orwell) — typographic zoom-through trailer

secondary_motion: no springs or overshoot; stamps hit without bounce; only slow pushes and light sweeps
color: desaturated low-key palette (colorfulness 17) with a single red accent
typography: big heavy-serif statements built word by word, zoomed through as transitions; not deformed or bouncing
shape_language: photographic/organic scenes plus crisp serif type and rectangular stamps
character_humor: silhouetted figures and a watching eye carry a story, but no acting or humor

signature: One lowercase heavy-serif statement per moody still, built word by word, then an accelerating zoom-through into a letter or the eye carries it out to the next scene.

music.summary: No clear beat (pulse clarity 0.10, ambient/score-led); cuts and accents ignore the grid, the only aligned hit is the stamp slam at 0.2 s, and pacing follows a regular ~2 s phrase cadence.

family_note: Elegant · Cinematic in restraint (desaturated, no springs, one statement at a time, smooth camera) but with editorial big type and a grim, gritty mood; the photo/still imagery with stamps and redaction marks also leans toward Mixed media. Proposed sub-style 'Cinematic editorial'.

behaviors.mechanism: camera scales into a letter of the headline (or the eye) with accelerating speed until the frame fills with black/the next image, cut at full speed
behaviors.notes: f18–f33 '1984'. Also 'rewriten.' 18 f (0.50,0.07,0.57,0.26 ~Launch 0.066) and eye 14 f to 11x (~Launch 0.113). Pure ease-in: per-frame scale factor rises from 1.01 to ~1.4.

behaviors.mechanism: lowercase heavy-serif statement appears one word at a time, left to right, with a fast left-to-right reveal inside each word
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets: 'you' f96, 'are' f99, 'always' f102, 'watched.' f105–f108; partial words 'the pa', 'watc' visible mid-reveal. Preset is the closest, not exact (no rise).

behaviors.mechanism: text never exits by itself: it is carried out by the zoom-through or erased as the light beam sweeps off left to right
behaviors.notes: Light-sweep erase f204–f216 read from sheet c.

behaviors.mechanism: red rubber stamp appears large and blurred and lands on the title/photo in 2 frames, no bounce; synced to the strongest audio onset
behaviors.notes: f2–f4 over '1984'; repeated on the evidence photos (f235–f238). Audio onset peak at ~0.2 s.

behaviors.mechanism: red square grows from the '!' stamp to fill the frame, then a window opens inside it onto the next scene
behaviors.notes: Width 64→1343 px (full frame) over f168–f175, near-linear slightly accelerating; bezier fit unstable so not reported. Window opening ~5 f read from sheet.

behaviors.mechanism: cursive handwriting writes on along the paper under the headline
'2+2=5' builds glyph by glyph over a dark room, then holds
behaviors.notes: f271–f289, intervals 3–6 f, read from sheet d.

behaviors.mechanism: every still keeps a slow push while the text holds; never fully static until the end poster
behaviors.notes: Start of the measured zoom-throughs: scale ~1.01–1.03 per frame before accelerating.

behaviors.mechanism: scene changes on a regular ~2 s cadence (one phrase per scene), not locked to a musical beat
behaviors.notes: Motion peaks at ~1.2, 3.2, 5.2, 7.25 s (energy.png); audio pulse clarity 0.10, accents on beat 0%.
